steps.content: The sea breeze. The air. The night. The stars.
The peaceful night sky ripples with an eerie disturbance. The stars lose their brilliance, turning murky and distorted.
The waves are whispering, the stars are watching, they're waiting for someone to understand them... or swallow them.
Since she was a little girl, she has always watched a sky like this one. And the stars have always watched her back.
Even after she lost her consciousness, left with only instinct, the stars have kept watching.

steps.speaker: Dreya
steps.content: You're... here.
Like before, Dreya is once again contaminated by Mania.

steps.speaker: Player
steps.content: You still love the stars so much.

steps.speaker: Dreya
steps.content: Yes... it's engraved into my instincts.

steps.speaker: Dreya
steps.content: But it feels like it's been a long, long time since I've watched them like this.

steps.speaker: Option
options: How about we stay and watch them a little longer?

steps.speaker: Dreya
steps.content: No, I'm not supposed to be here. I've already stayed too long.

steps.speaker: Player
steps.content: You're a part of Dreya. I believe in her... and I believe in you.
The person before you shakes her head.
Black slime drips from the sky, seeping into the ocean. The water churns for a moment before falling still.

steps.speaker: Dreya
steps.content: After all, this is a place built from data... and I'm merely an observer. I can gaze upon everything, but I can't have any of it.

steps.speaker: Dreya
steps.content: For the Dreya from that time to see the stars of decades to come... that's more than I could have ever hoped for.
For a moment, you see the Perishing Star that doomed the world. The source of calamity that Dreya spent a lifetime trying to understand, yet failed to prevent.

steps.speaker: Player
steps.content: Everything here is real. It left behind data because it existed, and that data formed this space.

steps.speaker: Player
steps.content: That's why... that's why it could bring you here. The fading wisp of your consciousness, buried in the depths of a dream, was given form and a place to stay.

steps.speaker: Dreya
steps.content: You're right. To be with people again after so long... Grilling seafood with them, surfing, tutoring...
Dreya keeps turning the astrolabe. With each spin, another piece breaks away, and the space around you shakes violently.

steps.speaker: Dreya
steps.content: This is more than enough. But our time is running short.
Thick sludge drips onto Dreya, but she makes no effort to resist.

steps.speaker: Dreya
steps.content: Until a moment ago, I've been wondering. Why am I here? When I disappear, where will my memories of you go?

steps.speaker: Dreya
steps.content: But seeing you... and seeing the others with you... I think I've found my answer.
Dreya stands up, gazing at the astrolabe in her hand. It melts into sludge, oozing through her fingers.
And in its place, an old, ornate gift box appears in her palm.

steps.speaker: Dreya
steps.content: Do you remember it?
Of course you do. It's the gift you gave Dreya.

steps.speaker: Dreya
steps.content: I think... these past few days we spent together will be like this gift box. Even if covered in filth, it will be kept safe in my dream.

steps.speaker: Player
steps.content: Yes. Just like you.

steps.speaker: Dreya
steps.content: Me? How is that possible... This entire space is...
Dreya stares at you in disbelief, then at the broken, crumbling space around her.
Cracks are rapidly expanding as dust and debris swirl like a storm. The boundaries of the space twist with a low groan, threatening to collapse at any moment.
Dreya comes to your side, urging you to leave before it all comes crashing down.
But you don't move an inch.

options: Trust in humanity, just as you always have.

steps.speaker: Player
steps.content: Humans will always push forward for what we hold dear. It doesn't matter if it's the truth, a lover... or a gift box full of memories.
Your anchor down the collapsing space with your shackles and meet Dreya's gaze.

steps.speaker: Player
steps.content: You are part of Dreya. You are her.

steps.speaker: Player
steps.content: No matter what you've forgotten, I'll help you remember it all again.
The gift box in Dreya's hands begins to glow with a soft blue light, growing brighter and brighter. And from within that light, the voices of your friends ring out, clear as day.

steps.speaker: Bai Yi
steps.content: Hey! Hurry up and deal with that Mania thing already! We can't run the shop without you!

steps.speaker: Jane
steps.content: Agreed. It's a real pain doing the books on our own.

steps.speaker: Lamia
steps.content: You can't die! Or I'm going to flunk my exam for sure!

steps.speaker: Dreya
steps.content: ...Alright.
Those familiar voices cut through the murmurs of the Mania, through all the filth and corruption, reaching her ears.
Slowly, she lowers her head, her gaze falling on the worn box in your hand.

steps.speaker: Dreya
steps.content: Haha...
A heartfelt smile finally blossoms on her pale lips.
So what I had forgotten... was it hope?
Light erupts from her palm, spreading in an unstoppable wave.
The moment the light touches the black sludge, the filth melts away like snow, vanishing as if it had never been there.
She looks up at the brilliant night sky, so different from the distorted, all-devouring sea of stars in her memory.

steps.speaker: Dreya
steps.content: ...No matter the era, humans are always so wonderfully naive.
The image of Dreya before you begins to fade, a sign she is about to disappear.

steps.speaker: Dreya
steps.content: Shall we do it one last time?

steps.speaker: Dreya
steps.content: Let's go surfing.
